0.original: <hex:024804F201FC03><hex:024904F201FD03> Quest Sync<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103><hex:02100103>The veteran hunter is sick of waiting around.

26.original: /cheer on the trainee hunter once more.

48.original: Rough place for a stroll, ain't it? I'm impressed ye made it out this far. If only my trainee had the same grit!

49.original: The plan was to go on a hunt together, but I haven't seen hide nor hair of her all day. I reckon the lightnin's got her scared stiff.

50.original: We're supposed to meet here, so I'd rather not step away if I can help it. Could ye swing through the outskirts and look for a fresh-faced hunter quakin' in her boots?

51.original: Me intuition tells me that fresh-faced hunter is still in the outskirts, draggin' her heels.

53.original: My mentor asked you to come find me!? Oh no... Well, I'm not proud to admit this, but that lightning is making me weak in the knees, and not in a good way.

54.original: This is rather embarrassing having only just met, but...it always helped to settle my nerves when the other hunters would <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>cheer<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> me on. Might I ask you to do the same?

55.original: Even the smallest <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>cheer<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> would go a long way to help settle my nerves.

56.original: The trainee hunter seems intimidated by the lightning. Perhaps you could <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>cheer<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> her on, that she might find the courage to carry out her duties.

57.original: Thanks... That helps a little. I think I'm feeling brave enough to finally set foot out there.

58.original: But, um... If you should notice me starting to lose my nerve, I hope you'll be there. To <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>cheer<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> me on again.

59.original: Aaaaaahhh! Nope! I can't do it! I-I just can't!

60.original: The trainee hunter is rapidly losing heart. <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Cheer<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> her on, that she may return to the fray.

61.original: Ugh... Thanks. Look, can I ask you something? How are you not terrified of the pylons?

62.original: I know they function as relay points for the energy gathered out here, but they quite literally <hex:021A020203>attract<hex:021A020103> lightning! Every strike is like an explosion, rattling me to the bone─I hate it!

63.original: Still, it's not much safer standing around here, so I may as well keep going... If I stop again, I need you to really <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>psych<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> me up, okay!?

64.original: <sob> I can't take this anymore! I want to go home!

65.original: The trainee hunter is paralyzed with fear. Is there aught you can do to <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>psych<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> her up?

66.original: Nnngh... I know it may not seem like it, but your moral support is a tremendous help right now, <hex:02080EE905FF056D697373FF0473697203>.

67.original: I'm so close to the rendezvous point, but the roar of the lightning really isn't helping my nerves... Maybe I'll pretend it's an asterodia! Yes, just a big, bloodthirsty asterodia...

68.original: I had to dodge some lightning bolts, but I made it! Thank you for giving me the push I needed!

69.original: My trainee here told me the whole story. Ye lit a proper fire in her belly, eh?

70.original: To her credit, she did well on the hunters' exam, and I reckon she's got promise. Not like she's the only one who's nervous about the lightnin', anyhow.

71.original: 'Sides, yer words of encouragement seem to have struck a chord with her, so I have faith she'll overcome it in time.

72.original: Now, if ye'll excuse us, we've got some monsters to hunt! Take care!
